name: Kaisi Teri Dillagi
overview: When a poor, street-smart girl is transformed into a sophisticated woman by the man she loves, she discovers that she is merely a pawn in his ruthless quest for revenge. Torn between her unrequited love for her manipulative mentor and the sincere affection of the man she is forced to marry, Kajri must break free from the strings that control her life and choose her own destiny.
